name: Anonymous Spain relocation service
description: Paperwork for moving to Spain. Digital nomad visas, NIE, TIE, and residency. Fees run from €199 to €3,000 a case. Marketed with Meta ads. One person. No outside money. Founded March 2024. No company name and no site. I am not guessing either.

mentions.evidence: Most of the money is a fee per case, so the subscription line is only $78.45 from 2 subscriptions. Last 30 days $1,237. Last 12 months $18,159. All-time $41,381. Last-30-day margin 55% claimed. Listed for sale at $45,000 (3.0x). Revenue synced 4 November 2026 ~02:00 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: A fixed fee for one painful form, in one country.

whyItPrints: People pay so they do not have to do the forms. Most of the money is a fee per case, not a seat every month. The listing is for sale.
whyThisMatters:
Someone in Spain does the paperwork for people who are moving there. Digital nomad visas, the NIE, the TIE, residency. A case costs from a couple of hundred euros up to a few thousand. The ads are on Meta. One person, no outside money, started in March 2024. No name. No site.

Stripe is connected, and it is a poor picture of a per-case business. The subscription line is under a hundred dollars, from two seats. The last thirty days are a bit over a thousand. The last year is most of the all-time total, which is still in the tens of thousands. Margin is claimed at fifty-five percent. The asking price is forty-five thousand, a few times a year of this pace.

You pay so the form is someone else's problem for that one visa.
